### Read the Bible: Leviticus 17, Psalms 20-21, Proverbs 31, and 1 Timothy 2
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/leviticus-17-psalms-20-21-proverbs-31-1-timothy-2/
Passage: Leviticus 17:1-9
Points:
- Restricting animal slaughter and sacrifice to the tabernacle stopped syncretism and pagan worship in open fields.
- Gathering worship at the sanctuary placed Israel under priestly guidance instead of superstitious rituals to manipulate God.
- God established specific mediators and offerings to emphasize His holiness and the true ugliness of sin.
- Requiring sacrifices exclusively at the tabernacle preserved the communal and covenantal unity of the nation.
- The prescribed sacrificial system foreshadowed the ultimate sacrifice, showing that sin must be atoned for on God's terms.
